title: Active-engine Top20 marginal hit-count calibration

hypothesis.question: Does the active engine's reconstructed Top20 hit-count distribution differ from the exact 5-of-40 hypergeometric null, with a persistent upper-tail advantage?
hypothesis.null: For every fixed pre-target 20-number set and a uniform 5-of-40 draw, H_t follows Hypergeometric(N=40,K=20,n=5).
hypothesis.status_note: This is a post-hoc diagnostic on a ledger already examined by Q113-Q115; it is not a virgin or prospectively preregistered experiment.

design.primary_endpoint: Blind OOS Pearson goodness-of-fit against exact Hypergeometric(40,20,5).
secondary_endpoints: Blind OOS two-sided mean-hit z test vs 2.5
Blind OOS one-sided exact binomial test for 5/5 Top20 hits.
design.multiple_testing: Holm across Pearson, mean and 5/5 endpoints for Discovery, Validation, Blind OOS and full sample (12 tests).
design.bootstrap: 10,000 circular block-bootstrap replicates, block length 20, fixed seeds per segment.

interpretation_guardrails: No model is fitted or selected; this is a calibration diagnostic only.
A nominal p-value in a historical split is not evidence of prospective predictive lift.
No production scorer, frozen forecast, or Q60 record may be changed by this experiment.
